title: Linus Karp Was Hit With an Umbrella is a definite must see of the Fri...
transcript: Linus CARPF was hit with an umbrella is the most personal show that Awkward Productions has brought to the fringe following their hits such as The Fit Prince and Diana, the Untold Story. Lina's Carp was hit with an umbrella follows a hate crime that Lina's Carp himself experienced on the streets of London right before coming to fringe in 2024. And through this incredibly traumatic experience, Lina's Carp has created a piece of art that is full of the anger but also so much empathy. And I think some of the magic of Lena's Carp was hit with an umbrella is how hopeful you feel leaving the theater despite how traumatic the event is. The show is hilarious and funny, has some great audience participation and an absolutely stellar performance from Linus Karp himself. This is easily one of my must sees of the fringe. I highly recommend it. It is playing at Underbelly, Bristol Square through the rest of the fringe.
